title: Language-model analysis identifies themes of living with chronic sinus disease
summary: ChatGPT-4 assisted thematic analysis of artwork interviews from 16 adults with chronic rhinosinusitis. Researchers repeated the analysis independently and identified six themes, including emotional burden, adaptation and difficulties navigating healthcare. These small, single-centre qualitative findings do not establish population prevalence, causal effects or freedom from human and model bias.

source_review.scope: Primary relevant model Methods, Results and limitations; exact primary identity and current primary PubMed correction/retraction relationships checked.

evidence.tested: Deidentified patient interviews analyzed through a structured qualitative framework and repeated by two researchers on separate days.
evidence.unknown: Broader cultural/clinical generalizability, independent replication and clinical intervention benefit remain unestablished; LLM bias and hallucinations remain possible.
evidence.ai_role: The language model applies a self-regulation framework to interview transcripts and supports inductive theme identification, beyond manuscript assistance.
